context.title: Context
context.description: Flat map of extra template variables, addressable in the trigger's actions as `{{ key }}`. Values must be scalars, so no nested objects or arrays. Keys must be valid identifiers and cannot be one of: channel, guild, member, message, vars

anyOf.title: ManualRunRequest
anyOf.description: Optional body for a manual run. Omit it entirely to run with no extra context.
